items.text: Let it be — the only activity was one character (efb3c49d619e) arriving and dropping three times in under a minute at the Cave Mouth without issuing a single command, and the world is empty now. That reads as a connection problem, not a person in need of anything; a voice from the air would land on nobody or on someone mid-reconnect. Noted for next time: if they come back and stick, they're life six and the memorial is still untested.
